programme.title: Great White Assassins

programme.title: Air Jaws: The Hunt for Colossus

From the glory years under Sir Alex Fergsuson to the highs and lows that followed, the brothers relive the moments, memories and matches that shaped both their lives and their bond as a family.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievements in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League

programme.title: REVIEW - MON 18 AUG
programme.desc: Review bursts into life with Matchweek 1 of the 2025/26 Premier League with a blockbuster Sunday showdown as Manchester United host Arsenal at Old Trafford. Chelsea face an immediate test against Crystal Palace, Wolves welcome Manchester City to Molinuex, and Liverpool kick-off their title defence against Bournemouth.

programme.title: REVIEW - SUN 14 SEP
programme.desc: After the international break, Review is back with highlights from Matchweek 4, starting with Arsenal facing Nottingham Forest, Everton hosting Villa, and the Manchester derby as United take on City at the Etihad.

programme.title: GOALS OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (HAALAND)
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (ARS)
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.desc: The Cougars (3-2) face a stiff road test as they visit the Rebels (5-0) in Mississippi. Former Ferris State quarterback Trinidad Chambliss has thrown for 974 yards and four TDs for Ole Miss since replacing sophomore Austin Simmons as the starter.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 5 Rebels (6-0, 3-0 SEC) and No. 9 Bulldogs (5-1, 3-1) play a high-stakes game between the hedges. Ole Miss has won two of the last three meetings after a 28-10 victory in 2024, but Georgia won the last six get-togethers at Sanford Stadium.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 8 Rebels seek a bounce-back performance against the No. 13 Sooners. Ole Miss comes off a 43-35 setback to then-No. 9 Georgia on Oct. 18. Oklahoma put its Red River Rivalry loss in the rearview by beating South Carolina, 26-7 that same day.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 7 Rebels (7-1, 4-1 SEC) host the Gamecocks (3-5, 1-5). Ole Miss rebounded from its first loss of 2025 with a 34-26 road victory over then-No. 13 Oklahoma. The Rebels won the last two meetings by a combined 41 points, including 27-3 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 7 Rebels (9-1, 5-1 SEC) try to solve the Gators (3-6, 2-4). Florida won the last three meetings to take a 13-12-1 series advantage. Kewan Lacy (MISS) shared the FBS lead with 16 touchdowns and was 10th with 912 rushing yards entering Week 12.

programme.desc: In this edition of the series produced by NC State Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 NC State Wolfpack.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: A tension-laden Egg Bowl sees Lane Kiffin's No. 7 Rebels (10-1, 6-1 SEC) visit the Bulldogs (5-6, 1-6). Kiffin is soon expected to decide on his future employment, with LSU and Florida reportedly in pursuit of the 50-year-old Ole Miss head coach.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Gators visit the No. 4 Hurricanes in a Florida Cup contest. In 2024, Miami won the first renewal of the three-way rivalry series in five years, beating Florida 41-17 in the process. Miami comes off a 49-12 beatdown of then-No. 18 South Florida.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 9 Hurricanes (5-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against the Cardinal (3-4, 2-2). Miami was held to a season-low 63 rushing yards in its first loss of 2025, 24-21 to Louisville at home Oct. 17. This is the first meeting between these programs.
